title: Tempo type
description: A yellow type specimen lifts, compresses or holds to an adjustable sixteen-beat cadence.
useCase: Visual rehearsal of rhythmic motion through typography.
interaction: Choose a pattern, start, and change BPM.
reducedMotion: Typography and beat position stay still; mode and tempo controls remain available.
limitations: A visual 40–160 BPM clock, not sample-accurate audio playback.
look: Saturated yellow field with one huge heavy black tightly tracked sans-serif word, monospace mode tabs, a sixteen-step beat rail and a tempo stepper.
motion: Once started, a 40–160 BPM clock pulses the word each beat with a decaying envelope (tall stretch, wide squash or dim, per mode) as a dot steps through sixteen ticks.
adapt: The beat loop is `draw`: `beats` advances from `bpm`, `envelope` decays quadratically over the first `0.57` of each beat, and `mode` maps it to a non-uniform scale (`0.23`, `0.22`) or opacity. Replace `modes`, which also supplies the displayed word.
